name: Nyotai Kyouran Princess in Prison
original_name: 女体狂乱プリンセス inプリズン
source:
The small kingdom of Yashuruna, protected by rich lands and sturdy castle walls, had long resisted the invasion of a military empire bent on conquering the continent.
Realizing that conquest by force alone would not work, the empire’s emperor ambushed and abducted the princess while she was visiting the battlefield to comfort her people.
With the princess taken hostage, the royal army could no longer fight freely for fear of what might happen to her, and the war gradually tipped in the empire’s favor.
When the princess learned that her homeland had been driven into a desperate situation, she resolved to escape the imperial castle for the kingdom, for her people, and for the soldiers who still believed in her and kept fighting.
But she had no way to slip past the heavy surveillance.
Just as she was sinking into despair, a doctor in the empire’s service appeared before her.

[Doctor]
“Then leave it to me.
I shall remake Your Highness’s body into one that can escape this castle.”

The treatment begins on the princess who has resolved herself for her homeland.
But it is nothing like ordinary cosmetic surgery.
It was female body remodeling...

[From the [url=https://www.ordin-soft.com/kaizou_prison.html]official website[/url]]
translation:
坐拥富饶国土与坚固城墙的小国亚什鲁纳，长久以来一直顽强抵御着企图称霸大陆的军事帝国的侵略。
意识到单靠武力难以征服该国，帝国皇帝便趁公主亲赴战场慰问军民之际设伏袭击，将公主掳为人质。
公主落入敌手后，王国军投鼠忌器、生怕危及公主安危而无法放手一搏，战局也随之渐渐向帝国一方倾斜。
得知祖国陷入绝境后，为了王国、为了子民，也为了那些依然相信自己并浴血奋战的将士们，公主下定决心要逃出帝国皇城。
然而面对森严的监视，她根本无计可施。
就在她陷入绝望之际，一名效命于帝国的医生出现在了她的面前。

【医生】
“那就交给我吧。
就由在下将公主殿下的玉体，改造成能够逃出这座城池的身躯。”

为了祖国下定决心的公主，就此接受了这场“治疗”。
然而那绝非寻常的整容手术，
而是一场彻底的肉体改造……

[摘自[url=https://www.ordin-soft.com/kaizou_prison.html]官方网站[/url]]
